Build clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs, buried under deprecation noise:

- `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, new bundler shape hands `retryCount`. Undefined `.toFixed()` crash. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined` flag (new config loader leaves unset flags undefined, not `false`). Simplified to boolean check, no throw.

Remaining 8 warnings all deprecation noise (`DEP0142`/`0198`/`0233`/`0250`/`0267`) — cosmetic, not blocking build. Exit 0 now.
